notes.title: M.A.C.E. Tower Defense 2
notes.content:
We are pleased to inform you that as of today, the product page of the 2nd part of the popular game M.A.C.E. Tower Defense  has been made public.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850740/MACE_Tower_Defense_2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29411660/07faaf76822bc102dbc6472abb6f353d27aefee4.jpg[/img][/url]


We are working hard to be able to release this game in Q3 2024. 
Please wish list M.A.C.E. Tower Defense 2, more information will follow there in the future.
